knowledge:
- key_parameters: referenceGenome=Specifies the genome version (e.g., 38) or "custom" for custom FASTA/GTF files ;; fromGDC=Logical parameter to process BAM files from the GDC Portal ;; notHSapiens=Set to TRUE for non-human species annotation ;; genesNames=Logical parameter in calculateGeneExpressionValues to convert Ensembl IDs to gene names ;; method=In batchEffectRemoval, choose "combat" or "sva" ;; cov=In DEGsExtraction, represents the coverage parameter (number of pathologies a gene can discern, default is 1) ;; mode=In featureSelection, choose "mrmr", "rf", or "da" (Disease Association) ;; mode=In dataPlot, controls visualization type ("boxplot", "orderedBoxplot", "genesBoxplot", "heatmap", "classResults", "heatmapResults", "confusionMatrix") ;; getEvidences=In DEGsToDiseases, set to TRUE to retrieve specific evidence types linking genes to diseases
- alternatives: hisat2 (via rawAlignment) for alignment ;; combat vs sva for batch effect correction ;; mRMR vs Random Forest vs Disease Association (DA-FS / DA-RED-FS) for feature selection ;; k-NN vs SVM vs Random Forest for machine learning classification
- when_to_use: Appropriate for complete transcriptomic workflows starting from raw RNA-seq data (SRA/GEO, ArrayExpress, GDC Portal) or count matrices, aiming to identify robust biomarkers, evaluate them using machine learning classifiers, and enrich them with biological annotations.
- pitfalls: Running rawAlignment requires downloading a pre-compiled "utils" folder containing external tools (Bowtie2, Hisat2, Htseq-count, Samtools, Sratoolkit, GDC-client) which must be decompressed in the project folder ;; GDC Portal BAM files require a token and manifest for download ;; Plotting genesBoxplot with a large number of genes can cause R to run out of memory; use a low number of genes (e.g., top 12) ;; geneOntologyEnrichment and DEGsToDiseases rely on external web services (DAVID, TargetValidation/Open Targets) which can fail if there are connection or host resolution issues.

workflows.name: raw_to_biomarkers_and_ml
workflows.intent: Process raw RNA-seq count files to normalize expression, remove batch effects, extract DEGs, perform machine learning classification, and retrieve biological enrichment.
input: mergedCountsInfo.csv (CSV file containing Run, Path, and Class columns for count files)
workflows.stages: 1. Merge count files into a single matrix using countsToMatrix ;; 2. Retrieve gene annotations using getGenesAnnotation ;; 3. Calculate normalized gene expression values using calculateGeneExpressionValues ;; 4. Plot expression boxplots using dataPlot ;; 5. Remove batch effects using batchEffectRemoval ;; 6. Extract differentially expressed genes (DEGs) using DEGsExtraction ;; 7. Visualize DEGs using dataPlot (orderedBoxplot, genesBoxplot, heatmap) ;; 8. Perform feature selection using featureSelection ;; 9. Train and evaluate classifiers (k-NN, SVM, RF) using cross-validation (knn_trn, svm_trn, rf_trn) ;; 10. Plot classification results and confusion matrices using dataPlot ;; 11. Test classifiers on independent test sets using test functions (knn_test, svm_test, rf_test) ;; 12. Perform biological enrichment (Gene Ontology, KEGG pathways, disease association) using geneOntologyEnrichment, DEGsToPathways, and DEGsToDiseases
workflows.code:
countsInformation <- countsToMatrix("mergedCountsInfo.csv", extension = "count")
countsMatrix <- countsInformation$countsMatrix
labels <- countsInformation$labels
myAnnotation <- getGenesAnnotation(rownames(countsMatrix))
expressionMatrix <- calculateGeneExpressionValues(countsMatrix,myAnnotation, genesNames = TRUE)
dataPlot(expressionMatrix,labels,mode = "boxplot", toPNG = TRUE, toPDF = TRUE)
batchGroups <- c(1,1,1,1,2,2,1,2,1,2)
expressionMatrixCorrected <- batchEffectRemoval(expressionMatrix, labels, batchGroups = batchGroups, method = "combat")
expressionMatrixCorrected <- batchEffectRemoval(expressionMatrix, labels, method = "sva")
DEGsInformation <- DEGsExtraction(expressionMatrixCorrected, labels, lfc = 1.0, pvalue = 0.01, number = 100, cov = 1)
topTable <- DEGsInformation$DEG_Results$DEGs_Table
DEGsMatrix <- DEGsInformation$DEG_Results$DEGs_Matrix
dataPlot(DEGsMatrix[1:12,],labels,mode = "orderedBoxplot",toPNG = FALSE,toPDF = FALSE)
dataPlot(DEGsMatrix[1:12,],labels,mode = "genesBoxplot",toPNG = FALSE,toPDF = FALSE)
dataPlot(DEGsMatrix[1:12,],labels,mode = "heatmap",toPNG = FALSE,toPDF = FALSE)
DEGsMatrixML <- t(DEGsMatrix)
mrmrRanking <- featureSelection(DEGsMatrixML,labels,colnames(DEGsMatrixML), mode = "mrmr")
rfRanking <- featureSelection(DEGsMatrixML,labels,colnames(DEGsMatrixML), mode = "rf")
daRanking <- featureSelection(DEGsMatrixML,labels,colnames(DEGsMatrixML), mode = "da", disease = "breast")
results_cv_knn <- knn_trn(DEGsMatrixML,labels,names(mrmrRanking)[1:10],5)
results_cv_svm <- svm_trn(DEGsMatrixML,labels,rfRanking[1:10],5)
results_cv_rf <- rf_trn(DEGsMatrixML,labels,names(daRanking)[1:10],5)
dataPlot(rbind(results_cv_knn$accuracy$meanAccuracy,results_cv_knn$accuracy$standardDeviation),mode = "classResults", legend = c("Mean Acc","Standard Deviation"), main = "Mean Accuracy with k-NN", xlab = "Genes", ylab = "Accuracy")
dataPlot(rbind(results_cv_knn$sensitivity$meanSensitivity,results_cv_knn$sensitivity$standardDeviation),mode = "classResults", legend = c("Mean Sens","Standard Deviation"), main = "Mean Sensitivity with k-NN", xlab = "Genes", ylab = "Sensitivity")
dataPlot(rbind(results_cv_knn$specificity$meanSpecificity,results_cv_knn$specificity$standardDeviation),mode = "classResults", legend = c("Mean Spec","Standard Deviation"), main = "Mean Specificity with k-NN", xlab = "Genes", ylab = "Specificity")
dataPlot(results_cv_knn,labels,mode = "heatmapResults")
allCfMats <- results_cv_knn$cfMats[[1]]$table + results_cv_knn$cfMats[[2]]$table + results_cv_knn$cfMats[[3]]$table + results_cv_knn$cfMats[[4]]$table + results_cv_knn$cfMats[[5]]$table
dataPlot(allCfMats,labels,mode = "confusionMatrix")
trainingMatrix <- DEGsMatrixML[c(1:4,6:9),]
trainingLabels <- labels[c(1:4,6:9)]
testMatrix <- DEGsMatrixML[c(5,10),]
testLabels <- labels[c(5,10)]
results_test_knn <- knn_test(trainingMatrix, trainingLabels, testMatrix, testLabels, names(mrmrRanking)[1:10], bestK = results_cv_knn$bestK)
results_test_svm <- svm_test(trainingMatrix, trainingLabels, testMatrix, testLabels, rfRanking[1:10], bestParameters = results_cv_svm$bestParameters)
results_test_rf <- rf_test(trainingMatrix, trainingLabels, testMatrix, testLabels, colnames(DEGsMatrixML)[1:10], results_cv_rf$bestParameters)
dataPlot(results_test_knn$accVector,mode = "classResults", main = "Accuracy with k-NN", xlab = "Genes", ylab = "Accuracy")
dataPlot(results_test_svm$accVector,mode = "classResults", main = "Accuracy with SVM", xlab = "Genes", ylab = "Accuracy")
dataPlot(results_test_rf$accVector,mode = "classResults", main = "Accuracy with RF", xlab = "Genes", ylab = "Accuracy")
GOsList <- geneOntologyEnrichment(names(mrmrRanking)[1:10], geneType='GENE_SYMBOL', pvalCutOff=0.1)
paths <- DEGsToPathways(names(mrmrRanking)[1:10])
diseasesTargetValidation <- DEGsToDiseases(rownames(DEGsMatrix)[1:5], getEvidences = FALSE)

workflows.name: automated_report
workflows.intent: Generate an automatic, intelligent HTML report summarizing the entire transcriptomic analysis pipeline in one step.
input: expressionMatrix (Matrix of normalized gene expression values)
workflows.stages: 1. Run knowseqReport to perform DEG extraction, feature selection, machine learning classification, and biological enrichment, outputting an HTML report.
workflows.code: knowseqReport(expressionMatrix,labels,'knowSeq-report',clasifAlgs=c('knn'),disease='breast-cancer', lfc = 2, pvalue = 0.001, geneOntology = T, getPathways = T)
